protocol: Questions and labels were written from human inspection of sampled frames (contact sheets at 1-2 fps plus full frames at 2, 10, 20, 30, 40 and 44 s) before the first SPORE run on this clip. The clip was not used to tune any default. A 'no' label means the object is not visible anywhere in this 45 s window, not that it is physically absent from the kitchen. The kitchen also contains a sink, a window, upper glass cabinets, a stove and a microwave in the early wide shot; these are outside the support ontology and are not queried.

questions.query: Is there a toaster on the countertop?
questions.human_evidence: White 4-slice toaster on the right side of the sink counter, visible in every sampled frame.

questions.query: Is there a rice cooker on the countertop?
questions.human_evidence: Silver/black rice cooker with a lit display at the centre of the sink counter, visible in every sampled frame.

questions.query: Is there a plate on the countertop?
questions.human_evidence: Two white plates on the left of the counter, one holding tomato and avocado slices.

questions.query: Is there a knife on the countertop?
questions.human_evidence: At 10 s the knife is resting on the wooden cutting board on the counter; it is held over the same board later in the clip.

questions.query: Is there a cutting board on the countertop?
questions.human_evidence: Wooden cutting board with bread and avocado at the right of the counter.

questions.query: Is there a mug on the shelf?
questions.human_evidence: Several white mugs are visible on the shelves inside the glass-front upper cabinet behind the counter. This is the hardest positive: the cabinet may not be labelled 'shelf'.

questions.query: Is there a kettle on the countertop?
questions.human_evidence: No kettle anywhere in the 42-frame 1 fps scan or the six full frames examined.

questions.query: Is there a blender on the countertop?
questions.human_evidence: No blender. A rice cooker and a toaster are present; neither is a blender.

questions.query: Is there a laptop on the countertop?
questions.human_evidence: No laptop in any sampled frame.

questions.query: Is there a hammer on the countertop?
questions.human_evidence: No hammer in any sampled frame.

questions.query: Is there a toothbrush on the countertop?
questions.human_evidence: No toothbrush in any sampled frame.

questions.query: Is there a basketball on the countertop?
questions.human_evidence: No basketball in any sampled frame.

questions.query: Is the toaster still on the countertop?
questions.human_evidence: Toaster remains on the right counter through the final sampled frame.

questions.query: Is the rice cooker still on the countertop?
questions.human_evidence: Rice cooker remains at the centre of the sink counter.

questions.query: Is the plate still on the countertop?
questions.human_evidence: The plate with tomato/avocado remains on the counter; the person moves food from it but does not move it to another surface.

questions.query: Is the mug still on the shelf?
questions.human_evidence: Mugs remain in the glass cabinet at the end of the clip.
Toaster is static for the whole window.
The plate is used in place on the counter; at the support level it does not move to another surface.
No kettle is visible, so there is no movement evidence to report.
